name: Synthetic Data D1 (Agent Studio only)
description: Agent Studio eval for the D1 synthetic-data workflow (5 agents, purely Agent Studio). Inputs map to the workflow variables target_tables, rows_per_table, database; expected_output describes the expected pipeline outcome (schema scan -> FK inference -> PII-free CSV generation -> FK patch -> quality scorecard). Running the live workflow requires iceberg-mcp-server pointed at the Impala database. Set database to the actual Impala DB at eval time.
